newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela gov't not decided on gasoline price rise.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela gov't not decided on gasoline price rise.

text.p: The Venezuelan government has not made any decision on an increase in the domestic price of gasoline, although the issue is being reviewed by the International Monetary Fund, a top government official said Tuesday.
"I insist that there is no date nor price to be announced for an increase in the price of gasoline," deputy Planning Minister Armando Leon said in an interview with the Venevision television network.
Leon said the gasoline price was one of three main issues being studied with an IMF team which arrived at the weekend to review Venezuela's economic progress.

The other issues were a restructuring of the Venezuelan Institute of Social Security (IVSS) and a revision of fiscal accounts, particularly government spending, in the light of recent pay increases for public sector workers.
